question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the word ‘endeavour’ given in the second paragraph.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Attempt".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word is **"endeavour"** which means to try very hard to do something, especially something difficult or new. (कोशिश)

 
 
• **Example:** *We will **endeavour** to resolve the issue.*
 
 
 
• In the context of the passage, the word **"endeavour"** is used to refer to a specific **effort or attempt** made towards achieving something.
 
• The synonym **"attempt"** conveys the idea of **undertaking actions** to attain a goal or objective, making it the most fitting alternative in this context.
 
• **Attempt:** It is an act of trying to do something. (प्रयास)
 
 
• **Example:** *An **attempt** was made to change the law.*
 
 
 
• The word **"attempt"** is a suitable synonym for **"endeavour"** in this context without changing the meaning of the sentence.
 
• Hence, the correct synonym is **"attempt".**

Therefore, the correct answer is** "Option 4".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Quit:** To leave, go away from a place or stop doing something. (छोड़ना)
 
• **Idle:** It means it's not in use or not active. (निष्क्रिय)
 
• **Drop:** It means to let something fall from a higher to a lower position. (गिराना)
